subject: Request: Price match vs. CloudAI + Migration comparison
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>; Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Competitive pricing - can Redwood match CloudAI?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the product demo last week — the performance looked solid and the A/B on latency was helpful for the eng team. We received a pricing summary from CloudAI that is materially lower for our expected monthly token volume, and Procurement is asking whether Redwood can match or at least come close on price and packaging if we commit to a 12-month reserved plan.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood provide a price match or a blended rate within 10% of CloudAI's list for generation and embeddings?
- What migration credits or technical assistance do you offer for a replacement (we have ~120M tokens / month currently)?
- Any limits on model variants or quantization that would affect performance SLA?

We have a tentative decision meeting on 10 Mar; procurement needs a clear comparative cost and migration estimate. Attaching CloudAI quote excerpt in-line below for context.

Appreciate a quick turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Senior Product Ops, NovaCorp

---Attached: CloudAI_quote_excerpt.pdf (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice@novacorp.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive pricing - can Redwood match CloudAI?

Hi Alice — thanks for the transparency and for sending the excerpt. I pulled together a quick top-line for comparison and next steps. Short answers up front:

- We can provide a targeted price match for committed Dedicated capacity + usage within a structured POC -> 12-month commit. We typically do this as a blended committed rate plus a migration credit to offset switch costs.
- Migration assistance: 40 hours of SE time + migration credits for token caching configuration and a migration runbook; optional paid Onsite/Hands-on support.
- Model variants: we support pinned model versions and compatible quantized builds; there are a few edge cases for custom kernels but we can document perf delta up front.

I'm attaching a draft Redwood vs CloudAI pricing matrix and a migration assumptions PDF. If you can share the CloudAI line items (per-token generation, embeddings, reserved discount) I'll firm this up.

Would you be available for a 30-min call Mon 1 Mar 10am PT to walk procurement through the numbers?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---Attached: NovaCorp_Redwood_vs_CloudAI_pricing_matrix_2026-02-28.xlsx; NovaCorp_migration_assumptions_2026-02-28.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Competitive pricing - can Redwood match CloudAI? (NovaCorp)

Team — forwarding NovaCorp's request. They asked for a price match within ~10% of CloudAI's quote for a 12-month reserved commit. Notes from the call: they run ~120M tokens/month, mostly generation with 15% embeddings. The decision meeting is scheduled for 10 Mar.

Asks:
- Rishi: can we offer a blended committed rate that gets within 10% of the CloudAI economics and still meets margin targets? If not exact, what concessions are acceptable (one-time migration credit, extended trial, reduced overage rates)?
- Karthik: estimate SE hours and any technical caveats around switching model builds / kernel compatibility; include any potential perf delta we should flag.
- Evelyn: if we pull a price match + migration credit, do we want a standard approval threshold from leadership?

Please reply with decision points and suggested offer by EOD today so I can respond to Alice after our 10am PT slot.

Thanks — Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Competitive pricing - can Redwood match CloudAI? (NovaCorp)

Marissa, quick calc: if NovaCorp commits to 12 months at their 120M tokens/mo profile, we can structure a reserved block + tiered overage that yields a blended unit cost within ~8% of CloudAI's quote by doing the following:

- Offer 10% discount on N1 reserved compute + 20% migration credit applied as a one-time bill credit (covers initial caching & integration run).
- Reduce per-embedding unit cost by 12% as a competitive sweetener (embeddings are a small part of their spend but high perceived value).
- Require a minimum 12-month commitment and a mutual action plan with checkpoints at 30/90/180 days.

Margin impact is manageable if we exclude premium SLA add-ons and cap the migration credit at a fixed dollar amount (we suggest $18k).

I recommend we proceed with the proposed terms; Evelyn sign-off required for the migration credit above $15k.

—Rishi
Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Wu <alice@novacorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 15:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive pricing - can Redwood match CloudAI?

Hi Alice — thanks again for the details and for the 10am PT call. Following internal review, here's a concrete offer we can present to NovaCorp: 

1) Economics: blended committed rate within ~8% of the CloudAI quote for your 120M tokens/month profile if you commit to a 12-month Dedicated reservation. Detailed line items attached.
2) Migration assistance: $18,000 one-time credit + 40 SE hours included (remote) to cover migration runbook, prefix/KV caching setup, and first-week tuning.
3) Embeddings: 12% off per-embedding unit price for the duration of the commit.
4) Lock-in & conditions: 12-month term, standard Redwood Dedicated SLA. Migration credit capped at $18k; additional on-site support quoted separately.
5) Next steps: mutual action plan + SOW/DocuSign. I'll open the HubSpot deal and share a Miro of the migration milestones if you want.

If this structure looks good, Procurement can send a short confirmation and we'll circulate the MSA + SOW. If you need a deeper TCO, Karthik and I can run a migration-sensitivity model (expected perf delta <5% on our quantized builds).

Appreciate you looping Procurement — happy to jump on a follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
